# Error codes

<!-- Generated by `npm run errors:doc` from lib/errors/codes.ts and lib/errors/pages.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every failure the user can see shows `RR-<AREA>-<NNN> · <PAGE>` (TECH_SPEC §1.5). The same list is in the app under Help.

## Codes

| Code | Title | User message | Severity | Retryable | Developer hint |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RR-APP-001` | This screen hit a problem | Something on this screen broke. Your routine is safe on this phone. | fatal | yes | Uncaught render error caught by a route error.tsx or SectionBoundary. |
| `RR-APP-002` | Something went wrong in the background | A background job failed. If it keeps happening, copy the details from Help. | error | no | window.onerror or unhandledrejection. Find the call site and give it a specific code. |
| `RR-APP-003` | Page not found | That page doesn't exist in Routine Raccoon. | error | no | Rendered by app/not-found.tsx. |
| `RR-APP-004` | This link is missing something | The link didn't say which item to open. | error | no | A required query param (id, section, plan, task) was missing or malformed. |
| `RR-APP-005` | A newer version is ready | Part of the app was updated. Reload to continue. | error | yes | ChunkLoadError: the installed bundle and a lazily loaded chunk disagree. |
| `RR-APP-006` | The app is misconfigured | This build has a configuration problem. | fatal | no | lib/env.ts rejected a NEXT_PUBLIC_ value (e.g. a secret key in a public variable). |
| `RR-DB-001` | Can't open your data on this phone | The app couldn't open its storage. Close other tabs of the app or restart it. | fatal | yes | Dexie open() failed: IndexedDB unavailable, blocked by another tab, or private mode. |
| `RR-DB-002` | Couldn't save that change | That change wasn't saved. Try again. | error | yes | A command transaction aborted. The cause is attached to the AppError. |
| `RR-DB-003` | Phone storage is full | Free up some space on your phone, then try again. | error | yes | QuotaExceededError from IndexedDB. |
| `RR-DB-004` | Couldn't upgrade your data | The app couldn't update how your data is stored. Nothing was deleted. | fatal | no | Dexie version upgrade() threw. Check the migration in data/db/schema.ts. |
| `RR-DB-005` | That item no longer exists | It may have been deleted or archived. | error | no | Lookup by id returned nothing or a tombstoned row. |
| `RR-DB-006` | Some saved data was unreadable | One item couldn't be read and was skipped. | warning | no | A JSON column failed Zod validation on read. The row is skipped, not deleted. |
| `RR-NET-001` | You're offline | No connection. Your day still works; we'll back it up when you're online. | warning | yes | fetch() rejected with TypeError or navigator.onLine is false. |
| `RR-NET-002` | The server took too long | The server didn't answer in time. We'll try again. | warning | yes | withTimeout() elapsed or HTTP 408/504. |
| `RR-NET-003` | Slowing down | Too many requests at once. We'll try again shortly. | warning | yes | HTTP 429 from Supabase or an Edge Function rate limit. |
| `RR-NET-004` | The server had a problem | Something went wrong on the server. We'll try again. | warning | yes | HTTP 5xx. |
| `RR-SYNC-001` | Couldn't back up your latest changes | Your changes are safe on this phone and will be backed up later. | warning | yes | Push phase failed after retries. Rows stay _dirty=1. |
| `RR-SYNC-002` | Couldn't fetch your saved copy | We'll try again soon. | warning | yes | Pull phase failed after retries. Cursor unchanged. |
| `RR-SYNC-003` | The server refused a change | One change couldn't be backed up. It's still on this phone. | error | no | Constraint violation (23xxx/22xxx). Row quarantined; see Account screen. |
| `RR-SYNC-004` | Couldn't combine the two copies | Nothing was lost. Try again, or choose a different option. | error | yes | mergeCopies() failed; local transaction rolled back. |
| `RR-AUTH-001` | Wrong email or password | That password doesn't match this account. | info | no | Supabase invalid_credentials. |
| `RR-AUTH-002` | Too many tries | Let's send you a code to reset your password instead. | info | no | Three failed password attempts in this session, or Supabase over_request_rate_limit. |
| `RR-AUTH-003` | That code didn't work | The code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one. | info | no | Supabase otp_expired / invalid OTP. |
| `RR-AUTH-004` | Please sign in again | Your session ended. Sign in to keep backing up. | warning | no | 401 / JWT expired / RLS 42501 for the current user. |
| `RR-AUTH-005` | Google sign-in didn't finish | Google sign-in was cancelled or failed. Try again. | info | yes | Credential Manager cancelled or signInWithIdToken rejected the token/nonce. |
| `RR-AUTH-006` | Couldn't check that email | We couldn't check the email right now. You can still continue. | warning | yes | auth-lookup Edge Function unavailable or rate limited. |
| `RR-AUTH-007` | Couldn't delete the account | Nothing was deleted. Try again. | error | yes | RPC delete_my_account failed (network, missing migration, or another app's foreign key blocked deleting the login). The transaction rolled back. |
| `RR-AUTH-008` | Accounts aren't set up in this build | Your day works fully on this phone. Account backup isn't available in this build. | info | no | NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL / _PUBLISHABLE_KEY not set. |
| `RR-AUTH-009` | Password too weak | Use at least 10 characters with a number or a symbol. | info | no | Supabase weak_password, or the client rules in domain/auth.ts. |
| `RR-AUTH-010` | Couldn't send the code | The email didn't go out. Wait a minute, then try again. | warning | yes | over_email_send_rate_limit or SMTP failure on signUp / resend / resetPasswordForEmail. |
| `RR-AUTH-011` | Check the email address | That email doesn't look right. Check it and try again. | info | no | domain/auth.ts isValidEmail rejected the input before calling the server. |
| `RR-AUTH-012` | Sign in again to delete | For your safety, deleting your account needs a fresh sign-in. Sign in again, then delete within 10 minutes. Nothing was deleted. | warning | no | delete_my_account requires the JWT's session (auth.sessions.created_at) to be under 10 minutes old. |
| `RR-VAL-001` | Name needed | Give it a name first. | info | no | Empty or whitespace-only name (tasks, sections, plans). |
| `RR-VAL-002` | Time out of range | Pick between 1 and 600 minutes. | info | no | tasks.minutes check constraint is 1–600. |
| `RR-VAL-003` | Video link not supported | Only YouTube and TikTok links can play inside the app. | info | no | domain/video.ts allowlist rejected the URL. |
| `RR-VAL-004` | Time looks wrong | That time doesn't look right. | info | no | Not HH:MM 24h. |
| `RR-VAL-005` | Primary plan is protected | Make another Day Plan primary first. | info | no | Primary plan cannot be deleted, archived or marked survival. |
| `RR-VAL-006` | Plan has no sections | {plan} has no sections yet. | info | no | Copy to a plan without sections. |
| `RR-VAL-007` | A section needs a Day Plan | This is the section's only Day Plan. Archive or delete the section instead. | info | no | removeSectionFromPlan / createSection with no live plan left. |
| `RR-VAL-008` | Can't be the primary Day Plan | Only a regular Day Plan can be primary. Take it out of Survival Mode first. | info | no | makePrimary on a survival or archived plan. |
| `RR-VAL-009` | All levels are taken | {name} already has three levels. Remove one first. | info | no | setSurvivalMembership(on) when levels 1–3 each have a live plan. |
| `RR-VAL-010` | Pick a section | Choose a section for it first, or add a new one. | info | no | Task form / paste import saved with no section selected (plan has none yet). |
| `RR-IMP-001` | Nothing to add | That paste didn't contain any tasks. | info | no | All lines were blank after parsing. |
| `RR-IMP-002` | Paste too long | Paste up to 200 lines at a time. | info | no | domain/paste-parser.ts MAX_PASTE_LINES. |
| `RR-MED-001` | The video couldn't load | Check your connection. The rest of the task still works. | warning | yes | Embed iframe failed or offline. |
| `RR-TMR-001` | Timer alert couldn't be set | The timer is running, but we couldn't set the alert for when it ends. | warning | yes | LocalNotifications.schedule rejected (exact alarm permission?). |
| `RR-NTF-001` | Notifications are off | Turn on notifications in your phone's settings to get section reminders. | info | no | Permission denied. |
| `RR-NTF-002` | Couldn't schedule reminders | Section reminders weren't scheduled. We'll try again next time you open the app. | warning | yes | Batch schedule failed. |
| `RR-PLAT-001` | Not available here | This needs the Android app. | info | no | Native-only capability called in the web build. |
| `RR-EXP-001` | Export didn't finish | Nothing was exported. Try again. | error | yes | Serialising or writing the export file failed. |
| `RR-AST-001` | Drafting limit reached | That's today's drafting limit. You can still write it yourself. | info | no | consume_assist_quota() returned false. Phase 3. |
| `RR-AST-002` | Drafting is unavailable | Claude couldn't draft this right now. You can still write it yourself. | warning | yes | assist-smaller-version Edge Function failed. Phase 3. |
